text:
Type: round plastic wall clock
Use: telling time on a wall; kitchen, home office, living room, study
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: molded plastic case in a matte finish, white face, black hands, red second hand
Colors: light grey, white, black, red accent
Shape: simple round case with a wide rounded rim, large clear black numerals, minute dots around the dial, slim black hands, compact and light
Feel: practical, clear, simple, everyday
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood desks, red or black accents; simple modern kitchens and home offices
